name: Pink & Pearl
description_html:
This flower arrangement has pink, white and peach ranunculus.

This elegant mix of bright pink, peach, and white ranunculus satisfies any mood, from playful to polite! This Bouq is a longtime customer favorite, and makes the ideal gift for yourself or someone who deserves a little extra attention. By ideal, we mean absolutely pearlfect.

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.

Please Note: While we always try our best to match the bouquet pictured, we remain dedicated to fresh, high-quality flowers. Occasionally substitutions including color variation or supplemental flower type may occur to ensure you receive our farmers’ freshest possible selection.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.

name: Day Dream
description_html:
Colorful arrangement that includes roses, delphinium, and ranunculus.

Head in the clouds, imagining the brightest summer blooms together in one bouquet? It’s real. Buoyant pops of bubblegum pink and tangerine dot this dreamy assortment of roses and ranunculus. Eucalyptus and delphinium stems add shots of cool color and extra height.

name: Standout
description_html:
A ranunculus bouquet in a rainbow of varying colors.

No stand-in could ever pass for these breathtaking blooms with fragrant eucalyptus accents! Vibrant ranunculus are known for their multiple layers of delicate, paper-thin petals. They’re so symmetric and long-lasting we sometimes can’t believe they’re real! But they are. Really!
